migration: Exact copy of all 60 original design/manifest/pixel files. Historical generator fields and firstOcrStatus are unchanged. Only new scripts/README/provenance/baseline are added.

maintainedGenerator.changes: Portable default paths, exact reference-manifest admission, full content verification before exclusive new-directory creation. Drawing/glyph/source-over logic is unchanged.
